Yes, Nerds Store offers express shipping, which usually takes 1 to 2 business days.
Is express shipping available for all items in the store?
The knowledge base does not specify whether express shipping is restricted to specific items. It only states that express shipping takes 1 to 2 business days.

The knowledge base does not provide a method to check express shipping availability for specific items before ordering. You may need to contact support at support@nerdsstore.example for confirmation.
